chunks: And it is narrated from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, that he said:
The thief is not to be cut off until he confesses to the theft twice. فإذا he retracts, he is liable for the stolen property, and he is not cut off if he has no witnesses against him.

key_terms.السَّارِقُ: the thief, the person accused of theft
key_terms.شُهُودٌ: witnesses whose testimony could establish the case

ai.seo_question: When is the hadd punishment for theft established by confession in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the hadd punishment for theft, requiring a double confession before amputation is carried out. If the accused retracts the confession and there are no witnesses, the hadd is not enforced, though liability for the stolen property remains.
